test_title: PYST 47: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: How are the proceedings and status of a Lok Adalat treated under Indian law?

options.text: Proceedings are judicial and Lok Adalat is deemed a civil court under CrPC.
Proceedings are advisory and Lok Adalat is not considered a civil court.
Proceedings are not judicial and have no legal standing in courts.
Proceedings are informal and not recognised under any law.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Proceedings are judicial and Lok Adalat is deemed a civil court under CrPC.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Lok Adalat is a statutory body under the **Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987**, established to provide speedy and amicable resolution of disputes.
 
• The proceedings of Lok Adalat are judicial in nature, and it functions as a civil court as defined under the **Code of Civil Procedure (CrPC).**
 
• Decisions made by Lok Adalat are legally binding, and the awards are enforceable as a decree of a civil court.
 
• Cases resolved in Lok Adalat are free from appeal unless parties find the outcome unsatisfactory and choose to pursue regular court proceedings.
 
• Lok Adalat promotes alternative dispute resolution (ADR) mechanisms to reduce pendency in courts and ensure quick access to justice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987:**

 
 
• It provides for the establishment of Lok Adalats and other institutions to ensure access to justice for all, particularly underprivileged sections.
 
• The Act empowers Lok Adalat to resolve disputes amicably through compromise and conciliation.
 
 
 
• **Jurisdiction of Lok Adalat:**
 
 
• Lok Adalat can handle cases related to civil disputes, family matters, motor accident claims, and small offenses not involving serious penalties.
 
• It cannot handle non-compoundable criminal cases.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of Lok Adalat:**
 
 
• It is cost-effective and eliminates lengthy court procedures.
 
• Parties save time and resources while ensuring resolution through mutual understanding.
 
 
 
• **Binding Nature of Lok Adalat Awards:**
 
 
• The decision of Lok Adalat is binding on all parties and holds the same status as a civil court decree.
 
• Parties retain the option to approach regular courts if dissatisfied, but appeals are rare due to the participatory nature of the process.
